rows.label: tlk45300054_03_msg0001
rows.name:
After Nopon, Superbians are the most
common people in Avaritia Trading
Company, right?

rows.label: tlk45300054_03_msg0002
rows.name:
There are quite a few people like
me who were born in Superbia but
choose to live here instead.

rows.label: tlk45300054_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Main reason for that is,
Superbia's Divine Beast
isn't an easy place to live.

rows.label: tlk45300054_03_msg0004
rows.name:
The ground is barren, and
not many crops grow there.

rows.label: tlk45300054_03_msg0005
rows.name:
A lot move to Gula, but there are
plenty of jobs here too.

rows.label: tlk45300054_03_msg0006
rows.name:
Not getting into the Superbian army
was one reason too, though.
